CAMEL-22445.title: Camel-AWS2-S3 Streaming Upload: Implement timestamp-based file grouping for AWS S3 streaming upload
CAMEL-22445.description: Add timestamp-based file grouping capability to AWS S3 streaming upload mode, allowing messages to be automatically grouped into time windows and written to the same S3 file based on their timestamps, enabling append-like behavior for time-series data.
